openai-codex/gpt-6-astra.character: Advisory: The advisor's own session model at xhigh. Planner and foreman nodes use high. Decision-bearing builders use medium, including backend, data, service, mixed-stack, debugging, and all UX implementation with frontend-design loaded. Fully locked execution packets use Astra low when the approach, surface, material decisions, and deterministic anchors are fixed; that executor owns ordinary local code choices, resolves environment and tooling obstacles locally and records them under Deviations, but stops and escalates on material ambiguity. Checker and reducer nodes use Astra low for fresh-context review and bounded synthesis. This profile recommends Codex models only.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.character: Advisory: The bounded scouting model at medium reasoning. Use it for source-linked investigation that reduces uncertainty before planning or implementation. Builders, review, reduction, and browser verification use the profile's Astra or Luna recommendations instead.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna.character: Advisory: The browser-verification model at max reasoning for integrated browser exercise and bounded evidence capture. Other semantic roles use Astra or Sol in this profile.
